decisions.rule: Times measured on different hardware are separate claims (paper_002: GPU and CPU).
Ranks that are compared must come from the same table; if no table holds both, mark them as not comparable. Applied: TabR and XGBoost both from paper_004 Table 4 (tuned).
Accepted: paper_003 xgboost_rmse = 0.433±1.6e-3 (Table 8, single tuned model).
Model variants with different results are separate claims, distinguished by model_variant (paper_008: DANet-20 and DANet-32).
